worldcombat.skill.barbbarrage.summary: Shake loose a fan of countless toxic barbs. The number of barbs grows with level and speed, and the total power is split across them; if even one lands it may poison the target. Against a target already poisoned the whole volley is doubled.
worldcombat.skill.barbbarrage.descriptio: One volley fires %1$s barbs across a %2$s degree half-angle.
The volley deals %1$s physical damage in total, split across the barbs; each barb flies at %2$s blocks per tick.
If at least one barb lands, there is a %1$s chance to poison the target for %2$s, each barb shoving it %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.barbbarrage.preference: On: barbs ×1.4 and poison chance ×1.15, but volley power ×0.85 and 2/3 ticks more recover and cooldown. Off: fewer, heavier barbs that hit a single target harder.
Beyond this distance the user closes in before firing a volley.
When on, the user may leave its post to find a firing line; when off, it only fires on what it can reach from where it stands.
